cues.text: World: the chat in the truck. Three shots (IMPROVE 00a). Frame 0, the cover, settled: the phone in its dash mount, header REVIEWS, and on its screen the hook card: "1-star" / "review just" / "landed." / "Your move." (the on-screen hook, 6 words), the REVIEWS CLINIC chip under it. The road rushes in the windshield, the air freshener swings. Host and dialog hidden. Cut in on "one-star" (by 0.8 s) to the close-up: the phone's screen fills the frame, and the example review big: one star lit of five, "The tech showed up late.", tagged EXAMPLE; the lit star pulses as "review" is said. The header plate reads "New 1-star review."; the reply box under the review holds "Copy this reply." Snow and the dialog box come on with the cut and stay.
Cut back out (before 2.6 s) to the truck: the card on the screen holds the hook; "Your move." gets an accent sweep and typing dots show under it. Snow points at the phone.
The card turns to the number: "43%" in the accent, "of contractors" / "don't answer" / "reviews". A "New review" notification drops in over the phone's top and goes back up; sparks on the 43%.
The source line types in under the card: ACHR News survey, 2024.
The scope lands in the accent under it: "on third-party sites".
World: the slot machine (level select). The crown reads ACHR NEWS + CLEAR SEAS; the reels idle on ?, ?, ?.
The lever pulls in 3 steps; the reels spin and stop left to right on 9, 1, % as "ninety-one percent" is said. The crown flips to SAY REVIEWS MATTER; bulbs chase, coins jump in the tray.
The plate under the reels types: "400 homeowners, 2024"; the bulbs chase faster.
The plate: "when they pick an HVAC contractor".
A second pull: the reels stop on 5, 6, %; the crown: LOOK ON GOOGLE.

World: the arcade high-score table (dissolve). Title DO CONTRACTORS ANSWER? The line under the rows: "Reviews on third-party sites". Row NO slides in first, 43% (said in the hook), the blinking row with the cursor.
Row YES slides in, counting to 45%; Snow points at it.
Row DON'T KNOW, 13% (on screen only). The source line: ACHR News survey, 2024.
World: the chat in the truck (iris). Header FIVE-STAR REPLY; an EXAMPLE tag on the pillar. The example review arrives: "5 stars. Fixed our furnace fast."
Our reply goes out a sentence at a time, each bubble on its first word: "Thanks for trusting us with your furnace."
"Glad it's running right."
"We're here when you need us." Read ticks light; the whole five-star thread holds 3 s or more, into the next take.

The five-star thread holds whole. A notification drops over it on "one-star": "New review: 1 star". On "reply" the header flips to ONE-STAR REPLY; the example review slides up: "1 star. The tech showed up late."
"Sorry we were late. That's on us."
"I want to make it right."
"Call me directly at the shop." Read ticks light. The whole one-star thread stays on screen from "Call" through the turn line, into "Answer your bad ones" (about 3.8 s).
The turn line, said over the finished one-star thread: a banner drops over the phone's top, "The part people skip", and holds; the thread stays whole under it.
World: the high-score table again (blinds), title THE PART PEOPLE SKIP, every row dashed; under them "Rules for every reply" until row BAD ONES: ANSWER lands on "bad".
Rows LENGTH: SHORT and TONE: CALM land on "short" and "calm".
Row DETAILS: OFFLINE.
Row ARGUING: NEVER, the blinking row; "Never argue in public." stamps in under the rows.
World: the chat in the truck (dissolve). Header ONE HONEST NOTE; typing dots.
Incoming: "The survey: reviews matter to homeowners."
Incoming: "It doesn't prove a reply wins the job."
A reminder banner drops: "Monday: reviews, 10 min". Our reply: "Every Monday. 10 minutes. Answer every new one." It holds to the end of the take.

World: the slot machine, a last pull (crown: ONE MORE PULL): the reels stop on Y, E, S; the crown: ANSWER EVERY REVIEW; the bulbs chase. A game window opens over the tray: "Don't leave reviews hanging." in the accent.
ProofNotFluff chip and the send line: "Send this to whoever runs your Google profile." One column, one left edge, host small at the side.
"The next 1-star gets a reply." lands in gold with an accent line sweeping under it; Snow waves.
